title: MeadTools Premium and general chat launch
summary: Draft for November 9 publication after activation is verified: premium brewing tools, MCP access, and general hosted-chat availability.

items: Premium is $5 per month and includes ingredient inventory with brew-linked stock deductions, equipment management, brew and timeline photos, and downloadable brew QR codes.
Photo storage includes 250 MiB per account and up to 20 images per brew. Existing free recipe-building, calculators, brew tracking, and sharing remain available.
Scheduled photo cleanup removes queued deleted and abandoned image objects and releases their reserved storage after cleanup succeeds.
Hosted chat is available to eligible active accounts without requiring premium. Prompts use your credit balance; premium includes 1,000 hosted-chat prompt credits per paid month.
Premium includes MCP access for compatible AI clients, with optional consent for private account reads. MCP tools do not spend hosted-chat prompt credits; your AI provider may charge separately.
